overall: The AG found no evidence the Committee created the flightpath "Municipal Working Groups" or that they were Committee subcommittees under the OML, so the complaint was resolved with no violation and no orders.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee's chair created flightpath-related subcommittees that failed to comply with the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we do not find that the groups with which the complaint is concerned were created by the Committee or are subcommittees of the Committee subject to the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint implied that a quorum of Committee members attended or deliberated at meetings of the flightpath groups.
allegations.key_passage: We also find no evidence that a quorum, 21 members, of the Committee attended or deliberated at a meeting of any group alleged to have violated the Open Meeting Law.
